```{r}
#| label: slides-setup
#| include: false

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(sf); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(purrr); library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork); library(scales); library(forcats); library(lubridate)
  library(spdep); library(gt)
})
source("R/utils.R")
source("R/ehsa.R")
sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE); set.seed(1234)

DER     <- "data/derived"
audit   <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "acled_audit.rds"))
ts_all  <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "township.rds"))
ts_an   <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "township_an.rds"))
ts_tot  <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "ts_tot.rds"))
state   <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "state.rds"))
panel_q <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "panel_q.rds"))
panel_y <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "panel_y.rds"))
LM      <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "lmsa.rds"))
EH      <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "ehsa.rds"))
MK      <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "markov.rds"))

N_TS <- nrow(ts_an); N_EV <- audit$loc_flow$analysed
q_lab <- function(d) paste0(year(d), " Q", quarter(d))

# The deck's paper colour. Figures are drawn on it rather than on white, so a
# plot does not read as a white card floating on the slide. Patchwork draws
# the frame around a composite with the default theme, so the default is
# changed too, and the PNG device is given the same background.
PAPER <- "#f7f7f5"
theme_update(plot.background = element_rect(fill = PAPER, colour = NA))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dev.args = list(bg = PAPER))

theme_slide <- function(base = 17) theme_th(base) +
  theme(plot.title    = element_text(size = rel(1.0),  margin = margin(b = 10)),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = rel(0.82), margin = margin(b = 12)),
        plot.background   = element_rect(fill = PAPER, colour = NA),
        panel.background  = element_rect(fill = PAPER, colour = NA),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = PAPER, colour = NA),
        legend.key        = element_rect(fill = PAPER, colour = NA))

theme_slide_map <- function(base = 15) theme_map(base) +
  theme(plot.title    = element_text(margin = margin(b = 10)),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(margin = margin(b = 12)),
        plot.background   = element_rect(fill = PAPER, colour = NA),
        panel.background  = element_rect(fill = PAPER, colour = NA),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = PAPER, colour = NA),
        legend.key        = element_rect(fill = PAPER, colour = NA))

smap <- function(layer, title = NULL, subtitle = NULL, base = 14, lw = 0.28) {
  ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = ts_all |> filter(!TS_PCODE %in% ts_an$TS_PCODE),
            fill = "#e7e5e4", colour = NA) +
    layer +
    geom_sf(data = state, fill = NA, colour = "#44403c", linewidth = lw) +
    coord_sf(datum = NA, expand = FALSE) +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle) +
    theme_slide_map(base)
}

lisa_sf <- ts_an |> select(TS_PCODE) |>
  right_join(LM$lisa, by = "TS_PCODE")
lc <- LM$lisa |> filter(var == "conflict")
side <- function(q, g) {
  l <- ifelse(q == "High-High", "hot", ifelse(q == "Low-Low", "cold", "none"))
  h <- ifelse(g == "Hot spot", "hot", ifelse(g == "Cold spot", "cold", "none"))
  sum(l == h)
}
gi_agree <- side(lc$quad, lc$gi_class)

ec <- tibble(TS_PCODE = EH$locs,
             cls = ehsa_label(EH$results$conflict$cls$classification),
             n_hot  = rowSums(EH$results$conflict$p_fold <= EH$alpha & EH$results$conflict$G > 0),
             n_cold = rowSums(EH$results$conflict$p_fold <= EH$alpha & EH$results$conflict$G < 0))
ec_sf <- ts_an |> select(TS_PCODE, TS, ST) |> left_join(ec, by = "TS_PCODE")
k_star <- min(EH$null_nq$k[EH$null_nq$surv_hot <= 0.01])

nat <- panel_q |> group_by(period) |>
  summarise(across(c(battles, erv, vac, fatalities), sum), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(conflict = battles + erv + vac)
pk <- nat |> slice_max(conflict, n = 1)

bq1 <- EH$bins_by_null |> filter(period == min(period))
ol  <- ts_an |> select(TS_PCODE, TS) |> left_join(MK$outlook, by = "TS_PCODE")
edge <- ol |> filter(own <= 2, lag == 4)
```

## <span class="en">Research question and key findings</span><span class="zh">研究问题与主要发现</span> {#findings}

::: {.eyebrow}
<span class="en">01 · WHERE, HOW IT EVOLVES, HOW IT SPREADS</span><span class="zh">01 · 在哪里、如何演变、如何扩散</span>
:::

::: {.card-grid .cols-3 .t-xs}
::: {.card .card-quiet}
[<span class="en">RQ1 · Where</span><span class="zh">RQ1 · 在哪里</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
*Where are the significant hot spots, cold spots and outliers of armed
conflict among Myanmar's townships?*
:::
::: {.zh}
*缅甸各镇区武装冲突的显著热点、冷点与异常值在哪里?*
:::
:::

::: {.card .card-quiet}
[<span class="en">RQ2 · How it evolves</span><span class="zh">RQ2 · 如何演变</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
*Which townships are new, persistent, sporadic or diminishing hot and cold
spots, quarter by quarter?*
:::
::: {.zh}
*逐季度来看,哪些镇区是新出现、持续、零星或减弱的热点与冷点?*
:::
:::

::: {.card .card-quiet}
[<span class="en">RQ3 · How it spreads</span><span class="zh">RQ3 · 如何扩散</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
*Does conflict spread to neighbouring townships, and does that start it or
escalate it?*
:::
::: {.zh}
*冲突会扩散到相邻镇区吗?它是引发冲突,还是使冲突升级?*
:::
:::
:::

::: {.kpi-row}
::: {.kpi}
[`r n_fmt(N_EV)`]{.kpi-val}
[<span class="en">Armed-conflict events analysed, 329 townships, 19 quarters</span><span class="zh">被分析的武装冲突事件,329 个镇区,19 个季度</span>]{.kpi-lab}
:::
::: {.kpi .kpi-fire}
[`r sum(lc$quad == "High-High")`]{.kpi-val}
[<span class="en">High-High townships: the Dry Zone and the south-east</span><span class="zh">「高-高」镇区:干燥带与东南</span>]{.kpi-lab}
:::
::: {.kpi .kpi-water}
[`r sprintf("%.2f", MK$fe$OR[3])`×]{.kpi-val}
[<span class="en">Odds of escalating per unit of neighbours' log conflict, with fixed effects</span><span class="zh">邻居冲突(对数)每增加一单位的升级优势比(含固定效应)</span>]{.kpi-lab}
:::
:::

::: {.card-grid .cols-3 .t-xs}
::: {.card .card-fire}
[<span class="en">Where</span><span class="zh">在哪里</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
One dominant cluster in the **Dry Zone** where Sagaing, Magway and Mandalay
meet; a weaker chain in the **south-east**; cold zones in the **delta,
Yangon and eastern Shan**.
:::
::: {.zh}
一个占主导的**干燥带**聚集(实皆、马圭、曼德勒交界);较弱的**东南**链条;冷区位于
**三角洲、仰光与掸邦东部**。
:::
:::

::: {.card}
[<span class="en">How it evolves</span><span class="zh">如何演变</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
A **stable core with moving edges**: new hot spots on the south and east of
the Dry Zone; Yangon turned **cold** after 2022. The off-the-shelf EHSA tool
needed **three corrections** first.
:::
::: {.zh}
**稳定的核心,移动的边缘**:干燥带南缘与东缘出现新热点;仰光在 2022 年后转为**冷点**。
现成的 EHSA 工具需要先做**三项修正**。
:::
:::

::: {.card .card-water}
[<span class="en">How it spreads</span><span class="zh">如何扩散</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
**Onset** in 2021 was nationwide and simultaneous. **Escalation** is
contagious: a township's next quarter depends on its neighbours.
:::
::: {.zh}
2021 年的**爆发**是全国同时发生的。**升级**则具有传染性:一个镇区下一季度的状况取决于
其邻居。
:::
:::
:::

```{r}
smap(geom_sf(data = d, aes(fill = cls), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.04),
     title = "Conflict events per township", subtitle = "Jan 2021 – Sep 2025", base = 13) +
  geom_text(data = pts, aes(x, y, label = ST), size = 2.3, colour = "#1c1917",
            check_overlap = TRUE) +
```

::: {.card-grid .cols-2}
::: {.card}
[<span class="en">ACLED events</span><span class="zh">ACLED 事件</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
`r n_fmt(audit$n_raw)` records, Jan 2021 – Sep 2025. Three armed-conflict
types kept: **battles, explosions/remote violence, violence against
civilians**, plus their fatalities.
:::
::: {.zh}
`r n_fmt(audit$n_raw)` 条记录,2021 年 1 月至 2025 年 9 月。保留三类武装冲突:
**战斗、爆炸/远程暴力、针对平民的暴力**,以及相应的死亡人数。
:::
:::

::: {.card}
[<span class="en">MIMU townships v9.4</span><span class="zh">MIMU 镇区 v9.4</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
330 townships; **329 analysed** (Cocokyun, 126 km offshore and without a
single event, excluded); two islands linked to the mainland.
:::
::: {.zh}
330 个镇区;**分析 329 个**(距岸 126 km、没有任何事件的 Cocokyun 被排除);两个岛屿
与大陆相连。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.card .card-fire}
[<span class="en">Land mines cleared</span><span class="zh">清除的地雷</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
- `r audit$loc_flow$city_only` conflict events known only to a **city**
  ("Mandalay – Unspecified") and `r audit$loc_flow$region_only` known only to a
  **district or state** would each have landed on one city-centre township:
  **excluded**.
- Events placed by **spatial join**, not by name; ACLED's own township agrees
  for `r sprintf("%.2f", audit$admin3_agreement_pct)`%.
- `r pct(100 * sum(audit$exclusion_by_type$prec2) / sum(audit$exclusion_by_type$analysed), 0)`
  of events are known only to the township, so **township and quarter** are
  the units, not points.
:::
::: {.zh}
- `r audit$loc_flow$city_only` 起只知道**城市**(「Mandalay – Unspecified」)的冲突事件,
  以及 `r audit$loc_flow$region_only` 起只知道**县或省邦**的事件,本会各自落到一个城市
  中心镇区:**予以排除**。
- 事件通过**空间连接**而非名称定位;与 ACLED 自身镇区的一致率为
  `r sprintf("%.2f", audit$admin3_agreement_pct)`%。
- `r pct(100 * sum(audit$exclusion_by_type$prec2) / sum(audit$exclusion_by_type$analysed), 0)`
  的事件只知道所在镇区,因此分析单元是**镇区与季度**,而不是点。
:::
:::

## <span class="en">Analytical approach</span><span class="zh">分析方法</span> {#approach}

::: {.eyebrow}
<span class="en">03 · METHODS</span><span class="zh">03 · 分析方法</span>
:::

::: {.card-grid .cols-4 .t-xs}
::: {.card .card-quiet}
[<span class="en">1 · Prepare</span><span class="zh">1 · 准备</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
Audit and screen events; join to townships; complete a **329 × 19
space-time cube** with zeros where nothing happened.
:::
::: {.zh}
审计与筛查事件;连接到镇区;构建完整的 **329 × 19 时空立方体**,无事件之处填零。
:::
:::

::: {.card}
[<span class="en">2 · LMSA</span><span class="zh">2 · LMSA</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
Global Moran's I, then **local Moran's I** (clusters, outliers) and **Gi\***
(hot, cold), 999 conditional permutations, FDR shown.
:::
::: {.zh}
全局 Moran's I,然后是**局部 Moran's I**(聚集、异常值)与 **Gi\***(热、冷),999 次
条件置换,并显示 FDR 结果。
:::
:::

::: {.card .card-fire}
[<span class="en">3 · EHSA</span><span class="zh">3 · EHSA</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
Space-time **Gi\*** per quarter, **Mann-Kendall** trend, Esri classes.
sfdep's tool **checked against an independent implementation** first.
:::
::: {.zh}
逐季度的时空 **Gi\***、**Mann-Kendall** 趋势、Esri 类别。先用**独立实现检验** sfdep 的工具。
:::
:::

::: {.card .card-water}
[<span class="en">4 · Value added</span><span class="zh">4 · 附加价值</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
**Spatial Markov chain** of conflict states, **fixed-effects** logit and
onset timing, each against a permutation null; **back-tested**.
:::
::: {.zh}
冲突状态的**空间马尔可夫链**、**固定效应** logit 与爆发时间,各自对照置换零模型;
并做**回测**。
:::
:::
:::

```{r}
#| label: slide-weights

lt <- LM$glob_year |>
  ggplot(aes(year, I)) +
  geom_line(colour = PAL$conflict, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(colour = PAL$conflict, size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", I)), vjust = -1, size = 4.4) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.7)) +
  labs(title = "Global Moran's I of conflict, by year",
       subtitle = "Every year p = 0.001: clustered, most of all in 2022–23",
       x = NULL, y = "Moran's I") +
  theme_slide(14)

gb <- LM$glob |>
  mutate(lab = c(conflict = "All conflict", battles = "Battles",
                 erv = "Remote violence", vac = "Violence vs civilians",
                 fatalities = "Fatalities")[var],
         lab = fct_reorder(lab, I)) |>
  ggplot(aes(I, lab)) +
  geom_col(fill = PAL$conflict, width = 0.62) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", I)), hjust = -0.2, size = 4.4) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.7)) +
  labs(title = "Whole period, by variable", subtitle = "Queen contiguity, row-standardised",
       x = "Moran's I", y = NULL) +
  theme_slide(14)

lt | gb
```

::: {.takeaway}
[<span class="en">Why check the tool</span><span class="zh">为什么要检验工具</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
A hot spot map that is wrong looks exactly like one that is right. Every
statistic here was **reproduced independently**, and each analytical choice
was **varied one at a time** to see what moves.
:::
::: {.zh}
一张错误的热点地图,看起来和正确的完全一样。这里的每个统计量都经过**独立复现**,每项
分析选择都**逐一改变**,以观察哪些结果会随之移动。
:::
:::

## <span class="en">How much conflict, when, and of what kind</span><span class="zh">冲突有多少、何时、何种类型</span> {#trend}

::: {.eyebrow}
<span class="en">04 · THE NATIONAL TRAJECTORY</span><span class="zh">04 · 全国走势</span>
:::

```{r}
#| label: slide-trend
#| fig-width: 15.5
#| fig-height: 5.2

marks <- tibble(date = as.Date(c("2021-02-01", "2021-09-07", "2023-10-27", "2025-03-28")),
                lab = c("Coup", "NUG declares\ndefensive war", "Operation\n1027", "Earthquake"))
type_cols <- c("Battles" = "#9f1239", "Explosions / remote violence" = "#f97316",
               "Violence against civilians" = "#475569")
p1 <- nat |>
  select(period, Battles = battles, `Explosions / remote violence` = erv,
         `Violence against civilians` = vac) |>
  pivot_longer(-period, names_to = "type", values_to = "n") |>
  mutate(type = factor(type, levels = names(type_cols))) |>
  ggplot(aes(period + 45, n, fill = type)) +
  geom_col(width = 80, colour = PAPER, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(data = marks, aes(xintercept = date), linetype = "22", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(data = marks, aes(x = date, y = Inf, label = lab), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            vjust = 1.1, hjust = -0.05, size = 3.8, lineheight = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(NULL, values = type_cols) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  labs(title = "Armed-conflict events per quarter", x = NULL, y = "Events") +
  theme_slide(14) + theme(legend.position = "top")

act <- audit$actor_year |>
  filter(event_type == "Explosions/Remote violence") |>
  mutate(actor = ifelse(actor_type == "State forces", "State forces", "Resistance and others")) |>
  group_by(year, actor) |> summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop_last") |>
  mutate(share = n / sum(n))
p2 <- ggplot(act, aes(factor(year), share, fill = actor)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = PAPER) +
  geom_text(data = act |> filter(actor == "State forces"),
            aes(label = percent(share, 1)), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            colour = "white", size = 4.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(NULL, values = c("State forces" = "#1e293b",
                                     "Resistance and others" = "#e11d48")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent()) +
  labs(title = "Remote violence changed hands", subtitle = "Who initiated explosions / remote violence",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_slide(14) + theme(legend.position = "top")

p1 + p2 + plot_layout(widths = c(1.7, 1))
```

::: {.card-grid .cols-3 .t-xs}
::: {.card}
::: {.en}
Conflict rose from `r n_fmt(nat$conflict[1])` events in 2021 Q1 to
**`r n_fmt(pk$conflict)` in `r q_lab(pk$period)`**, the quarter of Operation
1027, and has stayed near 3,000 a quarter since.
:::
::: {.zh}
冲突从 2021 年第一季度的 `r n_fmt(nat$conflict[1])` 起,升至 **`r q_lab(pk$period)` 的
`r n_fmt(pk$conflict)` 起**(1027 行动所在季度),此后一直维持在每季度约 3,000 起。
:::
:::
::: {.card .card-fire}
::: {.en}
**Remote violence is now the largest category**, and by 2025 the military
initiated `r percent(act$share[act$year == 2025 & act$actor == "State forces"], 1)`
of it: air strikes, drones and artillery.
:::
::: {.zh}
**远程暴力如今是最大的类别**,到 2025 年其中
`r percent(act$share[act$year == 2025 & act$actor == "State forces"], 1)` 由军方发起:
空袭、无人机与炮击。
:::
:::
::: {.card .card-water}
::: {.en}
The national series **trends strongly**, which is exactly what breaks the
standard EHSA null model (slide 9).
:::
::: {.zh}
全国序列**趋势明显**,这恰恰是标准 EHSA 零模型失效的原因(第 9 页)。
:::
:::
:::

```{r}
}
```

**`r sum(lc$quad == "High-High")` High-High townships**: a solid block in the

weaker **south-eastern** chain that does not.

::: {.zh}
**`r sum(lc$quad == "High-High")` 个「高-高」镇区**:**干燥带**(实皆–马圭–曼德勒)的
连片区块通过了 FDR 校正;较弱的**东南**链条则没有。

Violence against civilians is **almost all Dry Zone**; remote violence adds the
**south-east**. No significant High-Low outliers.
:::
::: {.zh}
针对平民的暴力**几乎全在干燥带**;远程暴力还延伸到**东南**。没有显著的「高-低」
异常值。

**`r sum(lc$quad == "Low-Low")` 个「低-低」镇区**:三角洲、仰光与掸邦东部山地。Gi\* 把

## <span class="en">Checking the emerging hot spot tool</span><span class="zh">检验新兴热点分析工具</span> {#check}

::: {.eyebrow}
<span class="en">07 · THREE DEFECTS IN sfdep 0.2.5, AND ONE TRAP</span><span class="zh">07 · sfdep 0.2.5 的三个缺陷与一个陷阱</span>
:::

```{r}
#| label: slide-check
#| fig-width: 15.5
#| fig-height: 4.6

tau_true <- tibble(location = EH$locs,
                   tau_me = apply(EH$results$conflict$G, 1, function(g) Kendall::MannKendall(g)$tau))
c1 <- ggplot(EH$validation$tau_mimu, aes(tau_me, tau_sf)) +
  geom_abline(colour = "#a8a29e") +
  geom_point(colour = PAL$conflict, alpha = 0.6, size = 1.6) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(title = "1 · Labels: tau reported vs true",
       subtitle = "Geometry not sorted by id: r = 0.12",
       x = "True tau", y = "Reported tau") +
  theme_slide(13)

bn <- EH$bins_by_null |> mutate(null = ifelse(grepl("sfdep", null), "sfdep (pooled)", "Corrected"))
c2 <- ggplot(bn, aes(period + 45, cold, colour = null)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) + geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(NULL, values = c("sfdep (pooled)" = "#a8a29e", "Corrected" = PAL$cool)) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  labs(title = "2 · Null: significant cold spots per quarter",
       subtitle = "Pooled null reads the national trend as local",
       x = NULL, y = "Townships") +
  theme_slide(13) + theme(legend.position = "inside",
                          legend.position.inside = c(0.72, 0.85))

nc <- EH$null_classes |> filter(class %in% c("Sporadic hot spot", "Consecutive hot spot",
                                             "Consecutive cold spot", "Sporadic cold spot",
                                             "No pattern detected")) |>
  mutate(class = fct_rev(droplevels(class)))
c3 <- ggplot(nc, aes(y = class)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = null_lo, xmax = null_hi), colour = "#a8a29e", linewidth = 4) +
  geom_point(aes(x = observed), colour = PAL$conflict, size = 3.4) +
  labs(title = "4 · Chance: classes vs random",
       subtitle = "Grey: 95% range by chance · red: observed",
       x = "Townships", y = NULL) +
  theme_slide(13)

c1 + c2 + c3 + plot_layout(widths = c(0.8, 1.2, 1.2))
```

::: {.card-grid .cols-4 .t-xxs}
::: {.card .card-fire}
[<span class="en">1 · Wrong township</span><span class="zh">1 · 张冠李戴</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
Unless the polygons are sorted by id, **`r pct(100 * EH$validation$share_wrong_mimu, 0)`**
of townships get another township's result.
:::
::: {.zh}
除非多边形按编号排序,否则 **`r pct(100 * EH$validation$share_wrong_mimu, 0)`** 的
镇区会拿到另一个镇区的结果。
:::
:::
::: {.card .card-fire}
[<span class="en">2 · Pooled null</span><span class="zh">2 · 混合零模型</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
2021 Q1: **`r bq1$cold[grepl("sfdep", bq1$null)]`** "significant" cold spots
against **`r bq1$cold[!grepl("sfdep", bq1$null)]`** with a same-quarter null.
:::
::: {.zh}
2021 年第一季度:**`r bq1$cold[grepl("sfdep", bq1$null)]`** 个「显著」冷点,而同季度
零模型下只有 **`r bq1$cold[!grepl("sfdep", bq1$null)]`** 个。
:::
:::
::: {.card .card-fire}
[<span class="en">3 · Class rule</span><span class="zh">3 · 分类规则</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
"Intensifying hot spot" ignores the sign: a township **cold in 18 of 19
quarters** was labelled one.
:::
::: {.zh}
「增强热点」规则忽略符号:一个 **19 个季度中 18 个为冷点**的镇区被贴上了这个标签。
:::
:::
::: {.card .card-water}
[<span class="en">4 · Chance</span><span class="zh">4 · 偶然</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
~`r round(EH$null_classes$null_mean[EH$null_classes$class == "Sporadic hot spot"])`
"sporadic hot spots" arise **by chance alone**; the count of hot quarters
matters more than the label.
:::
::: {.zh}
约 `r round(EH$null_classes$null_mean[EH$null_classes$class == "Sporadic hot spot"])` 个
「零星热点」**单凭偶然**就会出现;热季度数比标签更重要。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.eyebrow}

[<span class="en">Hot</span><span class="zh">热点</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
**Chronic core**: Myaing, Pakokku, Yesagyo, Salingyi and Singu hot every
quarter since late 2021, plus `r sum(ec$cls == "Sporadic hot spot" & ec$n_hot >= k_star)`
sporadic hot spots hot in `r k_star`+ quarters, Monywa among them. **New
edge**: Chauk, Nyaung-U, Pyinoolwin and Kyaukme, south and east of the
core, plus Meiktila and Kyaukse for single variables.
:::
::: {.zh}
**长期核心**:敏建、木各具、耶沙久、沙林基与新古自 2021 年底以来每季度都是热点;另有
`r sum(ec$cls == "Sporadic hot spot" & ec$n_hot >= k_star)` 个零星热点在 `r k_star` 个
以上季度为热点,包括蒙育瓦。**新边缘**:核心以南、以东的稍埠、良乌、眉谬与皎梅;单项变量中还有密铁拉与皎施。
:::
:::

::: {.card .card-water}
[<span class="en">Cold</span><span class="zh">冷点</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
**`r sum(ec$cls == "Consecutive cold spot")` consecutive** and
**`r sum(ec$cls == "Persistent cold spot")` persistent** cold spots (chance:
about 2 and 0). Eastern Shan and Wa: cold throughout. **Yangon: cold since
2022**, after the urban resistance was suppressed.
:::
::: {.zh}
**`r sum(ec$cls == "Consecutive cold spot")` 个连续**与 **`r sum(ec$cls == "Persistent cold spot")`
个持续**冷点(偶然情况下约为 2 与 0)。掸邦东部与佤地区:始终是冷点。**仰光:2022 年后
转冷**,源于城市抵抗被镇压。
:::
:::

[<span class="en">Watch</span><span class="zh">注意</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
Three of the five townships with the most events (**Kawkareik, Kale,
Hpakant**) show *no pattern*: a hot spot map is not a list of the most violent
places.
:::
::: {.zh}
事件最多的五个镇区中有三个(**高加力、葛礼、帕敢**)显示*无模式*:热点地图不是最暴力
地点的名单。
:::
:::

## <span class="en">Does conflict spread?</span><span class="zh">冲突会扩散吗?</span> {#spread}

::: {.eyebrow}
<span class="en">09 · VALUE-ADDED: SPATIAL MARKOV CHAIN AND EARLY WARNING</span><span class="zh">09 · 附加价值:空间马尔可夫链与预警</span>
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="58%"}
```{r}
#| label: slide-markov
#| fig-width: 9.4
#| fig-height: 6.8

st <- MK$markov$states
leave <- tibble(neigh = factor(st, levels = st),
                p = vapply(MK$markov$P_cond, function(P) 1 - P[1, 1], numeric(1)),
                esc = vapply(MK$markov$P_cond, function(P) sum(P[2, 3:4]), numeric(1))) |>
  pivot_longer(c(p, esc), names_to = "what", values_to = "prob") |>
  mutate(what = recode(what, p = "Quiet township sees conflict",
                       esc = "Sporadic township escalates to 4+ events"))
m1 <- ggplot(leave, aes(neigh, prob, fill = what)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.75), width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", prob)), position = position_dodge(0.75),
            vjust = -0.4, size = 4.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(NULL, values = c("#fda4af", PAL$conflict)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.7), labels = label_percent()) +
  labs(title = "Next quarter, by the neighbours' state now",
       subtitle = sprintf("%s transitions · permutation p = %.3f",
                          n_fmt(MK$markov$n_trans), MK$markov$p_Q_perm),
       x = "Neighbourhood this quarter", y = NULL) +
  theme_slide(14) + theme(legend.position = "top", legend.direction = "vertical")

m2 <- smap(list(geom_sf(data = ol, aes(fill = p_next), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.03),
                geom_sf(data = edge, fill = NA, colour = "#1c1917", linewidth = 0.6)),
           title = "Outlook, 2025 Q4", subtitle = "P(4+ events); outlined: the edge",
           base = 13, lw = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(NULL, colours = c("#fafaf9", "#fde0dd", "#f768a1", "#ae017e", "#49006a"),
                       limits = c(0, 1), labels = label_percent()) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm"))
m1 + m2 + plot_layout(widths = c(1.25, 1))
```
:::

::: {.column width="42%" .t-xs}
::: {.card .card-water}
[<span class="en">Escalation is contagious</span><span class="zh">升级具有传染性</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
A quiet township beside intense fighting is **about twice as likely** to see
conflict next quarter. With township and quarter **fixed effects** the odds
ratio is **`r sprintf("%.2f", MK$fe$OR[3])`** (95% CI
`r sprintf("%.2f–%.2f", MK$fe$lo[3], MK$fe$hi[3])`).
:::
::: {.zh}
与激烈战斗相邻的平静镇区,下一季度出现冲突的可能性**约为两倍**。加入镇区与季度
**固定效应**后,优势比为 **`r sprintf("%.2f", MK$fe$OR[3])`**(95% CI
`r sprintf("%.2f–%.2f", MK$fe$lo[3], MK$fe$hi[3])`)。
:::
:::

::: {.card}
[<span class="en">Onset was not</span><span class="zh">爆发则不然</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
First onsets are **no more clustered than chance** (p =
`r sprintf("%.2f", MK$onset$p)`): 2021 was a nationwide outbreak. Since 2023,
**every** new onset bordered an active township.
:::
::: {.zh}
首次爆发**不比偶然更聚集**(p = `r sprintf("%.2f", MK$onset$p)`):2021 年是全国性的
爆发。2023 年以来,**每一次**新爆发都与活跃镇区相邻。
:::
:::

::: {.card .card-fire}
[<span class="en">Back-tested</span><span class="zh">回测</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
Fitted to 2024, tested on 2025: the neighbourhood lifts AUC from
**`r sprintf("%.2f", MK$backtest$auc[1])` to `r sprintf("%.2f", MK$backtest$auc[2])`**.
`r nrow(edge)` edge townships are flagged for 2025 Q4.
:::
::: {.zh}
用截至 2024 年的数据拟合、在 2025 年检验:邻域信息使 AUC 从
**`r sprintf("%.2f", MK$backtest$auc[1])` 提高到 `r sprintf("%.2f", MK$backtest$auc[2])`**。
为 2025 年第四季度标出了 `r nrow(edge)` 个边缘镇区。
:::
:::
:::
:::

## <span class="en">Limitations and implications</span><span class="zh">局限与启示</span> {#implications}

::: {.eyebrow}
<span class="en">10 · FOR PEACE-BUILDING AND PUBLIC SAFETY</span><span class="zh">10 · 面向和平建设与公共安全</span>
:::

| <span class="en">Finding</span><span class="zh">研究结果</span> | <span class="en">Implication</span><span class="zh">启示</span> |
|---|---|
| <span class="en">Escalation spreads to neighbours, and the edge is predictable a quarter ahead</span><span class="zh">升级会向邻居扩散,边缘可以提前一个季度预测</span> | <span class="en">Pre-position protection, aid and monitoring in **edge townships** before violence arrives; refresh every quarter</span><span class="zh">在暴力到来之前,于**边缘镇区**预置保护、援助与监测;每季度更新</span> |
| <span class="en">Violence against civilians is moving south of the Dry Zone and into western Bago</span><span class="zh">针对平民的暴力正向干燥带以南与勃固西部移动</span> | <span class="en">Extend documentation and humanitarian access **south** of the Sagaing core</span><span class="zh">把记录工作与人道准入延伸到实皆核心以**南**</span> |
| <span class="en">Remote violence is the largest category and mostly the military's</span><span class="zh">远程暴力是最大的类别,且主要来自军方</span> | <span class="en">Plan early warning, shelter and medical capacity for a risk map **wider than the front line**</span><span class="zh">按照一张**比前线更宽**的风险地图,规划预警、避难与医疗能力</span> |
| <span class="en">Eastern Shan is cold throughout; Yangon became cold by suppression</span><span class="zh">掸邦东部始终是冷点;仰光则因镇压而变冷</span> | <span class="en">The first may suit local ceasefires and returns; the second is **not** a settlement</span><span class="zh">前者或许适合地方停火与返乡;后者**不是**和解</span> |

::: {.takeaway .takeaway-warn}
[<span class="en">Limitations</span><span class="zh">局限</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
**Recorded, not all, events**: reporting is thinnest where cold spots are.
**Counts, not risk**: no population figure survives three million
displacements. Results depend on **township, quarter and queen
contiguity**, and the diffusion results are **observational**.
:::
::: {.zh}
**被记录的事件,而非全部事件**:冷点所在之处恰是报道最薄弱的地方。**计数,而非风险**:
